import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, width=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score/Duration')
ax1.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Physical activity vs sleep quality scatter
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Daily Steps']/100, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. BMI category distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(bmi_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Blood pressure by BMI category
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, width=0.8)
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax4.legend(['Systolic', 'Diastolic'])
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Heart rate distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
ax5.hist(df['Heart Rate'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='skyblue')
ax5.axvline(df['Heart Rate'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, 
            label=f'Mean: {df["Heart Rate"].mean():.1f}')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily steps comparison
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
occupation_steps = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax6.barh(range(len(occupation_steps)), occupation_steps.values, color='lightcoral')
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_steps)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(occupation_steps.index)
ax6.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, occupation_steps.values)):
    ax6.text(value + 100, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{int(value)}', va='center', fontweight='bold')

# 7. Stress level by occupation
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
stress_data = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax7.bar(range(len(stress_data)), stress_data.values, color='orange', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(stress_data)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(stress_data.index, rotation=45)
ax7.set_title('Average Stress Level by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
ax7.set_xlabel('Occupation')
for i, v in enumerate(stress_data.values):
    ax7.text(i, v + 0.1, f'{v:.1f}', ha='center', fontweight='bold')

# 8. Correlation heatmap
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
                      center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Sleep disorder presence
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
has_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].apply(lambda x: 'Has Disorder' if x else 'No Disorder').value_counts()
colors = ['lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
bars = ax9.bar(has_disorder.index, has_disorder.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax9.set_title('Sleep Disorder Presence', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count')
for bar, value in zip(bars, has_disorder.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax9.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             f'{value} ({value/len(df)*100:.0f}%)', ha='center', fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Health and Sleep Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
